title: Summer Palace · East Palace Gate

buildingCutout.basis: Only occupied footprints of the documented buildings are replaced.

note: The East Palace Gate is fitted to the occupied footprint on the approach to the Hall of Benevolence and Longevity. The three passages show the door leaves open. Bronze lions and the central stair relief are interpreted from photographs. Separate service ranges in the forecourt remain map geometry. Preview places the authored base at the recorded absolute sea-level elevation; local tide and terrain resolution remain host-dependent.
